what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Vietnam in Peru: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 72 Vietnamese asylum seekers in Peru, 0.4% of all asylum seekers from Vietnam.
Refugees from Vietnam, a separate group, live mostly in France, the United Kingdom, Germany and Thailand.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Vietnam, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2023.
The figure stayed between 61 and 72 from 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Peru.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Peru only.
